message: Vector Rebel 3.2.89: explain current PPE pending items, show OFF staff, and label/acknowledge historical alerts.
releaseNotes: Daily Captain Check now shows all selected regular crew, including personnel marked OFF both days. The current-tour summary distinguishes native completed checks, no native completion found yet, unreadable Item Logs, and unmapped PPE. A collapsible per-item list identifies exactly which gear needs review and explicitly states that pending is NOT a failed physical inspection. Amber pending rows are no longer displayed as red historical misses. Current C-shift crew confirmation is held until same-date existing Rebel Command Captain duty has been read or a clear 12-second timeout asks the Captain to verify manually; this prevents a quick click preserving stale HERE defaults, including Jerry Weems. When a saved Captain report and confirmed Rebel Command duty conflict, an explicit warning and Correct Today's Crew control let the Captain fix attendance using saved native records without repeating the full read. The minimized icon calls 21 alerts diagnostic reports, not failed PPE checks. Errors & Alerts categorizes reports by program and offers one confirmed Mark All Reviewed action. REVIEWING is acknowledgement only, not resolved or deleted; all items remain recorded in Rebel Command. No official check, CrewSense write, email, or cross-device user data was modified.
